item.title: Grenade exercise sparked deadly fire at Canada military base, army says
item.description: High winds propelled the blaze across the army base in Wainwright, killing four soldiers and injuring dozens more.

item.description: Karachi's last two African elephants remain in captivity. Their sisters are already dead. Will they survive?

item.title: Israel arrests 36 Palestinians in the West Bank, attacks on farmers ramp up
item.description: Israeli pogroms on Palestinian farmers and their lands during the olive harvest season intensify.

item.title: Trump backs Ramaswamy ad featuring rival Amy Acton’s estranged mother
item.description: Trump advises the Republican gubernatorial candidate to keep running the controversial advertisement.

item.description: UK Conservative Party MP says the party does not condone former member's conduct, revealed in Al Jazeera investigation.
